nodes.summary: The surface count `2d (2n + 1)^{d - 1}` of the box `Λ_n`.

nodes.title: Edge-volume count of a box

nodes.summary: A pointwise limit `g` of convex functions on `ℝ` is convex; its one-sided derivatives exist, are monotone, are one-sided limits of slopes, and agree off a countable set; slopes of the approximants converge to slopes of `g`.
nodes.title: Pointwise limits of convex maps are convex with one-sided derivatives

nodes.summary: The centered free energies of the boxes `Λ_n` converge pointwise to `G`, and `G(0) = 0`.
nodes.title: Pointwise convergence of box centered free energies

nodes.summary: The centered free energy `F_G(t) - F_G(0)`, with `F_G = ivp2_ambientTiltLogZ G q`. In the FK range `q > 0`, the ambient non-edge offset cancels in this difference.
nodes.title: Centered free energy of a graph

nodes.summary: The wired centered free energy, obtained by subtracting `wpd_wiredAmbientTiltLogZ G bdry q 0` from its value at `t`. In the FK range `q > 0`, the ambient non-edge offset cancels.
nodes.title: Wired centered free energy

nodes.summary: Adding edges with both endpoints in `{v | p v}` lowers the number of connected components by at most `|{v | p v}|`. See also `card_connectedComponent_le_sup_fromEdgeSet` (`EdgeMarginal`) for the bound by the number of added edges.
nodes.title: Adding edges within a vertex set drops components by at most its size

nodes.summary: A convex function on `ℝ` has equal left and right derivatives off a countable set.
nodes.title: Convex function has equal one-sided derivatives off a countable set

nodes.summary: The set of parameters at which `μ p` and `ν p` differ on some increasing event is countable, under the hypotheses of `fk_uniqueness_of_pressure_convex`.
nodes.title: Set where coupled measures differ is countable under a convex pressure

nodes.summary: The free `q = 2` density of every edge of `Λ_N` at `p = logistic(t)` is the left derivative of `g` at `t`.
nodes.title: Free edge densities on a box as left derivatives

nodes.summary: The wired `q = 2` density of every edge of `Λ_N` at `p = logistic(t)` is the right derivative of `g` at `t`.
nodes.title: Wired edge densities on a box as right derivatives

nodes.summary: The wired `q = 2` density of every edge of `Λ_N` at `p = logistic(t)` is at most the right derivative of `g` at `t`.
nodes.title: Wired edge densities on a box bounded by right derivatives

nodes.summary: If `μ p` and `ν p` are monotonically coupled, the edge density of `ν p` at `e` is the right derivative of a convex `g`, and all edge marginals agree wherever that density is continuous in `p`, then `μ p` and `ν p` agree on every increasing event for `p` off a countable set.
nodes.title: Coupled measures agree off a countable set, given a convex pressure

nodes.summary: Under `FKSecantData`, at `q = 2` there is a countable set `S` of parameters off which every measure `φ` whose box-edge marginal lies between the free and wired ones has the same marginal as both.
nodes.title: Box-edge marginal uniqueness off a countable set under tilt data

nodes.summary: Under `fsc_FreeEnergyData`, at `q = 2` there is a countable set `S` of parameters off which every measure `φ` whose box-edge marginal lies between the free and wired ones has the same marginal as both.
nodes.title: Edge-marginal uniqueness off a countable set from convex free energy

nodes.summary: Finite-volume tilt data for the box edge `eb` at `q = 2`: volumes `V n → ∞` and surface terms `S n = o(V n)` such that, for all `p' < p` in `(0, 1)` and `ε > 0`, `ε ≤ 2 ^ (S n) λ ^ ((θ^w(p') - θ^f(p) - 2ε) V n) / ε` with `λ = tiltFactor p p'`, where `θ^w` and `θ^f` are the wired and free infinite-volume densities of the edge.
nodes.title: Finite-volume tilt data for a box edge at $q = 2$

nodes.summary: The average edge densities of the graphs `Gn n` converge to the free infinite-volume `q = 2` density of every edge of `Λ_N`, at every `t`.
nodes.title: Collapse of average edge densities to the free density

nodes.summary: The average edge density `|E|^{-1} E_{φ_{G,p,2}}[#open edges]` at `p = logistic(t)`.
nodes.title: Average edge density of the $q = 2$ random-cluster measure

nodes.summary: The wired and free `q = 2` infinite-volume densities of every edge of `Λ_N` at `p = logistic(t)` are the right and left derivatives of `g` at `t`.
nodes.title: Infinite-volume edge densities as one-sided derivatives

nodes.summary: Softplus is a convex function whose one-sided derivatives are both `fsc_logistic`, so the derivative conditions in `fsc_FreeEnergyData` can hold for some convex function.
nodes.title: Softplus is convex with both one-sided derivatives logistic

nodes.summary: The convex free-energy hypothesis for the box edge `eb` at `q = 2`: some convex `g` has right derivative `t ↦ θ^w(fsc_logistic t)` and left derivative `t ↦ θ^f(fsc_logistic t)`, the wired and free infinite-volume densities of the edge.
nodes.title: Convex free-energy hypothesis for a box edge at $q = 2$

nodes.summary: The logistic map `t ↦ eᵗ / (1 + eᵗ)`, equal to Mathlib's `Real.sigmoid` (`fsc_logistic_eq_sigmoid`).

nodes.summary: The logit `p ↦ log (p / (1 - p))`, inverse to `fsc_logistic` on `(0, 1)`.

nodes.summary: Under `fsc_FreeEnergyData`, the wired edge density at `p'` is at most the free edge density at `p` whenever `p' < p`.

nodes.summary: The softplus function `t ↦ log (1 + eᵗ)`.

nodes.summary: Under `FKSecantData`, the wired edge density at `p'` is at most the free edge density at `p` whenever `p' < p`.
nodes.title: Tilt data give wired density at $p'$ at most free density at $p > p'$

nodes.summary: The ambient logit normalizer `|E|⁻¹ log (fkZ G p q) + log (1 + eᵗ)`, with `p = fsc_logistic t`. For `|E| > 0`, the added term removes the Bernoulli denominator, not the unused-coordinate factor in `fkZ`. At zero edges this definition uses totalized real division and equals `log (1 + eᵗ)`; no per-edge physical interpretation is intended.

nodes.summary: A pointwise limit of convex functions on `ℝ` along a nontrivial filter is convex.

nodes.summary: Every pointwise limit of finite-volume ambient tilted log normalizers along a nontrivial filter is convex.

nodes.summary: If for every `ε > 0` the bound `ε ≤ q ^ (S n) λ ^ ((b - a - 2ε) V n) / ε` holds for all `n`, with `V n → ∞` and `S n = o(V n)`, then `b ≤ a`.

nodes.summary: If `ε ≤ q ^ (S n) λ ^ (m V n) / ε` for all `n`, with `q ≥ 1`, `0 < λ < 1`, `V n → ∞` and `S n / V n → 0`, then `m ≤ 0`.

nodes.summary: The per-edge ambient tilted log normalizers of a sequence of graphs on the fixed box `Λ_N` take finitely many values.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
